scenes.title: Auckland Glazed Wind-Tunnel Test Bay
scenes.institution: Aerodynamics Laboratory — Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Transparent side panels expose a long white interior test corridor. A tall clear vertical fixture with circular endplate stands near the glazed wall. Dark exterior framing and adjoining instrument space contrast with the white tunnel lining. The reviewed view is a local side view with reflections; floor plan and hidden return paths are not known. A mechanical calibration specimen may replace pictured test articles; aerodynamic forces remain unmodeled.

Original benign mechanical motion and inert coupon only; no material failure law or certified load rating.
